sections.注意事項:
Health Insurance (mandatory) : All exchange students are required to purchase a University of Scranton health insurance policy for the duration of their stay at the University. The cost of insurance is approximately $120 per month which will be automatically charged to your University account.
Meningitis Immunization (mandatory) : ALL students attending The University of Scranton must show proof of meningitis immunization. If you do not have the necessary documentation, or have not been immunized against meningitis, you must go to the Student Health Center upon arrival for this immunization. The health insurance which we will be purchasing, will not cover immunization, therefore, we recommend that you get your immunization at your home country.
Student Fee (mandatory) : ALL University of Scranton students are required to pay a Student Fee each semester. Currently the fee is $100/semester. This fee enables you to use all equipment at our state of the art facility: gym, exercise equipment, weights, swimming pool, basketball courts, and more.

MANDATORY VACCINE FOR BACTERIAL MENINGITIS: The state of Texas requires that all students enrolling in a college or university are required to have a vaccine against bacterial meningitis (meningococcal vaccine). Exchange students cannot pre-register online, but have to register their courses personally at the different academic departments during the two-day orientation session. Once you have identified your preliminary course choice, the process of registration will be as follows: Some weeks before the semester starts, all students will be contacted by email and asked about their preliminary course selection and about the academic departments the chosen courses belong to. Each faculty and academic department at the Ibero is represented by an academic coordinator, who has to approve your participation in the courses you choose. This formal approval will occur during the two-day orientation session at the Ibero. During this session, you will have appointments with the different coordinators who correspond to your courses. We will schedule these appointments on the basis of your preliminary course choice.
All students are required to have a medical insurance to prevent any emergencies that may occur during their stay in our country. A copy of the insurance policy must be sent together with the application documents, or two weeks before the semester starts at the latest. If you don't know how to obtain a medical insurance, we will gladly inform you about some options.

交換生沒有任何必修課，可以上任何課（除了師範學院和醫科學院，護理學院的課程）有‘Korean Language Practice’是專為交換生開設的韓語課程，剛開始學韓語且韓語水準很低的學生可以選擇這門課。選好了在第一周的時候記得要參加分班考試。

換課只能是開學第一周可以換，1周以後沒法改課。第一周指定的時間內必須想好自己到底上什麼課。
4. 成績單
當你交換結束之後，可以在學校的國際處或留學辦公室要啟明大學的成績單。這是啟明大學免費寄過去的，而且有了成績單之後馬上寄到自己所屬學校國際處辦公室。

Our accommodation is designed so you can find a balance between privacy and social life that best suits your own lifestyle. Some rooms even come with a view of Mount Fuji!
* Depending on availability, Fall 2022/Spring 2023 exchange students may live in the iCLA residence hall, other university housing, or off-campus apartments.
